id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID (passport, national identity card, or equivalent) required at the exam centre.
exam_rules: No electronic devices or reference materials permitted. Oral exams conducted in person with a trained examiner. Listening tasks are played via audio recording; earphones not provided.
renewal_options: CELI and CILS certificates have lifetime validity — they do not expire.

prerequisites.description: None; near-native or mastery-level Italian. Recognised as the highest Italian language certificate for professional and academic purposes worldwide.

retake_policy.notes: No official waiting period. Candidates may re-sit at the next available exam session (exams held 2–4 times per year depending on centre and level).

domains.name: Comprensione della Lettura — Reading (literary, philosophical, and specialised texts; stylistic analysis)
Produzione Scritta — Writing (academic essay, literary commentary, critical analysis)
Comprensione dell'Ascolto — Listening (complex debates, literary readings, philosophical discussions)
Produzione Orale — Speaking (spontaneous, precise argumentation; nuanced register mastery)

lifecycle.summary: The issuer's CVCL centre (Universita per Stranieri di Perugia) lists the full live CELI ladder on its 'Esami CELI generici' page (last updated 27-03-2025): 'CELI Impatto (Livello A1 del QCER) CELI 1 (Livello A2 del QCER) CELI 2 (Livello B1 del QCER) CELI 3 (Livello B2 del QCER) CELI 4 (Livello C1 del QCER) CELI 5 (Livello C2 del QCER)', so CELI 5 (C2) is offered now. The site also runs live 'Iscrizione Esami CELI' and 'Calendario Esami CELI e DILS-PG' sections.
